capabilities: Render bitfield definitions as interactive SVG diagrams
Switch between diagram and HTML table views
Auto-fill unfilled bits as reserved at the MSB end
Configure color schemes and row heights for diagrams and tables
disambiguation: Not a binary data editor; it only renders bitfield definitions written in fenced code blocks.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is written in Chinese.
motivation: Built for chip front-end engineers to view bitfield layouts directly in their notes.
problem: Chip engineers cannot view register bitfield layouts directly inside their notes; Obsidian has no built-in way to render bitfield definitions.
summary: Renders bitfield definitions in bitfield code blocks as interactive SVG bitfield diagrams and HTML tables with dual index labels.
